posts.content:
95% reliability sounds pretty good.

Until you need it 10 times in a row.

That’s one of the problems our engineering team ran into while building the Vanta Agent: the more work we asked the model to do just to retrieve data, the more opportunities we created for things to go wrong.

So we changed the job.

Let the model decide what information it needs. Let deterministic code handle how to get it.

The result: ~27% lower cost per task and a 45%+ improvement in task completion on complex analytical queries.

Vanta Sr. Software Engineer Chris Ng gets into what we changed (and what we learned about designing tools for agents) in the latest Trustcraft: https://bit.ly/461DVbW

posts.content:
Some of the tasks on a CISO's list aren't overdue. They're undead. 🧟‍♂️ 

We looked at task data across 16K orgs and found that the first dedicated security hire closes 96% of their tasks... But by the time a CISO owns the program, half the list is sitting open, and a third of it hasn't been touched in over 2 months.

Nobody got worse at the job; the job changed. At scale, security stops fixing problems and starts identifying problems for other people to fix. Your name stays on the ticket, but the kill switch doesn't. 

Usually that ticket is deprovisioning, like a former employee, still live in Google Workspace, a month after they left.

We call it zombie work: full accountability, partial control, and the burnout variable nobody names.

If half your list is open, that's structural. Here's what's actually in the pile: https://bit.ly/4wWlMac

And here’s her story...

After graduation Christina joined Union Square Ventures as an investor, and after meeting 100s of founders, she finally realized there was no single type of successful entrepreneur.

So she quit to launch her first startup, Nebula Labs which ultimately failed. But it led her to joining Dropbox as a product manager, where she learned first hand how big of a bottleneck audit and compliance was for startups.

So she teamed up with Erik Goldman, to launch Vanta, the Agentic Trust Platform that automates compliance with over 35 security and privacy frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and more.

Vanta doesn’t just simplify compliance, it connects with internal tools and systems, so your team is always audit ready. And that’s why today, 16,000+ companies like Ramp, Cursor, and Harvey run on Vanta!
